summary: Wellchange Holdings Co Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of independent director Mr. Shi Zhu, effective July 27, 2026, with no stated disagreement. The board now consists of five directors, maintaining a majority of independent directors. Board committees remain unchanged. This is a routine directorship change without forced departure or strategic event, thus classified under Management Changes only if abrupt; no terms date, price, or advisor mentioned. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report; no special-situation catalyst or risk-arb angle identified.
